features.title: Reality bender
features.text: Witchwarpers draw magic from alternate realities. Their paradox determines whether they cast arcane or occult spells and how their quantum field changes the battlefield.

features.title: Quantum field
features.text: Keep this zone active to use warp focus spells. Casting one on your turn also sustains the field. Each spell sets its own targets and area.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3–4 → 3–4.5. Offensive spells can raise damage; zone-control loadouts emphasize support.
ratings.defense: 2.5 → 2.5–3.5. Protective spells and paradox choices alter personal resilience.
ratings.support: 4 → 4–5. Quantum fields and control spells reshape the battlefield for allies.
ratings.utility: 4 → 4–5. Tradition, spells and paradox choices offer broad but differing exploration tools.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 4. Manage the quantum field, spell resources and paradox interactions.
